------------------------------------------------------------------------
Beginning as a hobby I have stuck with the medium. I was able to work as a Ceramic Studio Technician / Teachers Assistant at Denison University, working under Professor Justin Coleman and Head Studio Tech Shahid Khan I learned to mix clays and glazes as well as fix electrical or mechanical issues with our kilns, wheels or mixers. I would be grateful for the opportunity to get into a similar position in the future. 

In practice my art focuses on function over design. I hope to get further into mixed media elements potentially combining carpentry, and electrical lighting into my art.

# Gallery

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

imgs <- list.files(
  "ceramic_images",
  pattern = "\\.(jpe?g|png)$",
  ignore.case = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)

cat("::: {layout-ncol=3}\n\n")
for (f in imgs) {
  label <- gsub("_", " ", tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(f)))
  cat(sprintf("![%s](%s){fig-alt=\"%s\"}\n\n", label, f, label))
}
cat(":::\n")
```
